ETH.note: AI liveness detection is part of a document authentication app, not an AI tool giving a decision inside a named public sector system.

facts.fact: Ethio Telecom's teleSign app, launched 30-31 March 2026 with the Ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice and the Federal Documents Authentication and Registration Service, checks users online through integration with the Fayda National Digital ID plus AI video liveness detection.

ETH.note: Nothing on a link between the civil register and the ID system.
Says teleSign data sits on Ethio Telecom's cloud 'reinforcing national data sovereignty', without stating government data, ownership or a rule.
No count or share of people holding a national ID is stated.
Nothing on an ID number given at birth.
Nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the ID system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.
Fayda is named only as integrated; nothing on its issuing, biometrics or certification.

facts.fact: Ethio Telecom's teleSign platform, live from 30 March 2026, verifies users for online document authentication, power of attorney and licensing services through integration with the Fayda National Digital ID.
